title: Clidle
summary: Wordle with a running score: guess the five-letter word in six tries.
description: Type a word and press Enter. Green letters are in the right place, yellow ones are in the word but elsewhere, grey ones aren't in it; the keyboard below keeps track. A win scores 100 for one guess down to 50 for six, added to your total. New word starts another game.

saves.notes: Every game and guess, for the running total score.

verification.notes: Host test: six guesses to the end of a game at 58x30, its saved history, and a new game.
